name: Kohlrabi
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's low in fermentable carbohydrates. Start with smaller portions if very sensitive.
preparationTips: Peel the tough outer skin before eating or cooking
Can be eaten raw in salads or slaws for a crisp texture
Steam, roast, or sauté for 10-15 minutes until tender
Young kohlrabi leaves are also edible and low FODMAP
